purpose: Encoder embeddings for every official BraTS 2020 subject, graded from the release's name_mapping.csv. Replaces epoch_001.npz (datasets/brats2021_hdf5, untraceable IDs and grades) as the input to the full-coverage kernel comparison.
preprocessing: ingest._ingest_subject -> normalize_slice -> centred fit_to_grid; no augmentation, no synthetic degradation
encoder_training_note: The encoder was trained (segmentation, presence, size, quality, morphology-contrastive) on the 258 'train' subjects. Grade was never a training target. Val and test subjects (111) never influenced weights.
